gels.name: Strep pull-down
gels.title: Optimisation A: MUT no RBC lysis, Strep-bead pre-clearing
gels.source: Biologics > Prenylation / MKV project > '04/11/26 Optimization A and B' (reactions 04/11/26, gel 05/11/26)

notes.Samples: MUT 1401+1399, blood bled 19/08/26 and pooled; whole-blood lysate with no RBC lysis (180.4 µg/µL by BCA), stored at -80 °C.
notes.Processing: Lysate diluted 1 in 2 or 1 in 10 in prenylation buffer. 100 µL of each on 40 µL Dynabeads MyOne Streptavidin T1 (washed 2x PBS, 1x prenylation buffer), 45 min end-over-end at 4 °C; 13 µL of the cleared supernatant into the assay. Beads then washed 5x PBS and boiled in loading buffer, 95 °C 10 min.
notes.Conditions: Not cleared vs Strep-cleared lysate, both through the full prenylation reaction; plus the bead eluates (what streptavidin pulled out before the reaction: the endogenous biotinylated proteins, here ~250, ~120 and ~75 kDa apparent).
notes.Loading: 1 in 10 lysate: 235 µg in the reaction (less after clearing). Bead eluates: everything the beads held from 100 µL of diluted lysate (9.0 mg protein at 1 in 2, 1.8 mg at 1 in 10).
notes.Aim: Optimisation A: clear the endogenous biotinylated background bands from the blot.
notes.Left out: 1 in 2 not cleared and 1 in 2 Strep-cleared: overloaded smears, no usable bands.
notes.Image: Exported, annotated figure (8-bit, contrast already set), not the raw scan.
notes.Assay: 13 µL lysate + 7 µL mix (RabGGTase II, REP1, biotin-GPP to 5 µM, DTT to 5 mM, in prenylation buffer), 5 h room temp, then -80 °C. Licor 4x loading buffer + 10% β-ME, 95 °C 5 min; 23 µL on Bio-Rad Criterion TGX 4-20%, 150 V 50 min; Trans-Blot Turbo to low-fluorescence PVDF; Licor Intercept block 1.5 h; Licor streptavidin (red) 1:5000, 1 h; 3x TBST; Odyssey.

gels.dropped: MUT 1in2 not cleared and MUT 1in2 Strep-cleared (x 296-360, 385-450): overloaded smears, no usable bands

gels.name: Reaction drop-outs
gels.title: Optimisation B: HET and MUT 1x RBC lysis, neat, reaction drop-outs
gels.source: Biologics > Prenylation / MKV project > '04/11/26 Optimization A and B' (reactions 04/11/26, gel 05/11/26)

notes.Samples: HET and MUT whole-blood lysates after 1x RBC (ACK) lysis. The page doesn't name the mice; presumably the 19/08/26 lysates (HET 1403+1402, MUT 1401+1399).
notes.Processing: Lysate neat into the assay. Full reactions from a master mix; drop-outs made individually, the missing component replaced by prenylation buffer.
notes.Conditions: full; no REP1; no RabGGTase II; no B-GPP (shows what streptavidin sees with no biotin label: the endogenous biotinylated proteins only).
notes.Loading: 13 µL of neat lysate; µg not recorded on this page (if these are the 19/08/26 lysates: HET 133 µg, MUT 82 µg).
notes.Aim: Optimisation B: is there enough endogenous REP1 / RabGGTase in the lysate for the reaction to run without the added enzyme?
notes.Image: Exported, annotated figure (8-bit, contrast already set), not the raw scan.
notes.Assay: 13 µL lysate + 7 µL mix (RabGGTase II, REP1, biotin-GPP to 5 µM, DTT to 5 mM, in prenylation buffer), 5 h room temp, then -80 °C. Licor 4x loading buffer + 10% β-ME, 95 °C 5 min; 23 µL on Bio-Rad Criterion TGX 4-20%, 150 V 50 min; Trans-Blot Turbo to low-fluorescence PVDF; Licor Intercept block 1.5 h; Licor streptavidin (red) 1:5000, 1 h; 3x TBST; Odyssey.

gels.name: Frozen blood ± inhibitor
gels.title: Frozen blood, HET (AV/+) vs MUT (AV/AV), with and without protease inhibitor
gels.source: Biologics > Prenylation / MKV project > '24/09/26 Frozen blood processing opt' (gel 25/09/26)

notes.Samples: pMVK mice bled, blood frozen in two ~300 µL tubes per mouse. HET = 161 AV/+ (no prenylation defect); MUT = 156 AV/AV (prenylation defect).
notes.Processing: Added to the still-frozen blood, then thawed on ice ~30 min; 7000 g 5 min 4 °C; washed once in 1 mL PBS (no RBC lysis); pellet in 100 µL prenylation buffer; sonicated 10 pulses; 17000 g 10 min 4 °C. No BCA.
notes.Conditions: +CPI: 60 µL of 50x CPI diluted 1 in 10 (→ 1x); no CPI: 60 µL milliQ (vehicle). Lysate into the assay neat, 1 in 10 or 1 in 50 (≈ 1:2, 1:20 and 1:100 of the earlier 500 µL no-lysis runs, as only ~300 µL blood).
notes.Loading: 13 µL of (diluted) lysate; µg not measured.
notes.Aim: Can frozen blood be processed for the assay, and does a protease inhibitor help?
notes.Image: Raw JPEG export (lane labels from a separately annotated copy).
notes.Assay: 13 µL lysate + 7 µL mix (RabGGTase II, REP1, biotin-GPP to 5 µM, DTT to 5 mM, in prenylation buffer), 5 h room temp, then -80 °C. Licor 4x loading buffer + 10% β-ME, 95 °C 5 min; 23 µL on Bio-Rad Criterion TGX 4-20%, 150 V 50 min; Trans-Blot Turbo to low-fluorescence PVDF; Licor Intercept block 1.5 h; Licor streptavidin (red) 1:5000, 1 h; 3x TBST; Odyssey.

gels.name: RBC lysis
gels.title: RBC lysis optimisation: HET and MUT, 1x or 3x ACK lysis
gels.source: Biologics > Prenylation / MKV project > 'RBC lysis optimization' (bled 19/08/26, image 210826_Het_Mut_IVP_Opt_2.tif)

notes.Samples: Bled retro-orbitally 19/08/26 (~750 µL per mouse), pooled in pairs: HET = 1403+1402, MUT = 1401+1399; 500 µL of pooled blood per condition.
notes.Processing: 1x RBC lysis: one 10 mL ACK, 5 min RT. 3x RBC lysis: three 2 mL ACK, 5 min RT each. Washed in PBS, pellet in prenylation buffer (80 µL for 1x, 40 µL for 3x), sonicated (10 or 4-5 pulses), spun; protein by BCA.
notes.Conditions: No, 1x or 3x RBC lysis; HET vs MUT.
notes.Loading: The same 13 µL of lysate in every reaction regardless of protein (to see whether haemoglobin interferes), so loads differ: 1x HET 133 / MUT 82 µg; 3x HET 3.8 / MUT 7.2 µg.
notes.Aim: Does RBC lysis remove the haemoglobin smear, and can the assay see a signal?
notes.Left out: No-RBC-lysis lanes (HET 2946 µg, MUT 2346 µg): one saturated smear.
notes.Assay: 13 µL lysate + 7 µL mix (RabGGTase II, REP1, biotin-GPP to 5 µM, DTT to 5 mM, in prenylation buffer), 5 h room temp, then -80 °C. Licor 4x loading buffer + 10% β-ME, 95 °C 5 min; 23 µL on Bio-Rad Criterion TGX 4-20%, 150 V 50 min; Trans-Blot Turbo to low-fluorescence PVDF; Licor Intercept block 1.5 h; Licor streptavidin (red) 1:5000, 1 h; 3x TBST; Odyssey.

gels.dropped: HET and MUT no RBC lysis (x 395-450, 450-505): one shared, saturated smear, no usable bands

gels.name: Serial dilution
gels.title: Serial dilution of no-RBC-lysis lysate, HET and MUT
gels.source: Biologics > Prenylation / MKV project > 'RBC lysis optimization' (reactions 17/09/26, gel 18/09/26; annotated image)

notes.Samples: the rbc lysis gel's no-RBC-lysis lysates: HET 1403+1402 (226.6 µg/µL), MUT 1401+1399 (180.4 µg/µL), bled 19/08/26, stored at -80 °C.
notes.Processing: Serially diluted in prenylation buffer: 1 in 2, 5, 10, 100, 1000, 10 000.
notes.Loading: 13 µL of each dilution: from 1473 / 1173 µg (1 in 2) down to 0.29 / 0.23 µg (1 in 10 000).
notes.Aim: See the background prenylation, and find a dilution with clear bands instead of a smear.
notes.Left out: 1 in 2 lanes: HET nearly blank, MUT one saturated smear.
notes.Image: Annotated export (WebP); stain made with blocking buffer reused from the block step.
notes.Assay: 13 µL lysate + 7 µL mix (RabGGTase II, REP1, biotin-GPP to 5 µM, DTT to 5 mM, in prenylation buffer), 5 h room temp, then -80 °C. Licor 4x loading buffer + 10% β-ME, 95 °C 5 min; 23 µL on Bio-Rad Criterion TGX 4-20%, 150 V 50 min; Trans-Blot Turbo to low-fluorescence PVDF; Licor Intercept block 1.5 h; Licor streptavidin (red) 1:5000, 1 h; 3x TBST; Odyssey.

gels.dropped: HET 1in2 and MUT 1in2 (x 110-210, 240-375): HET nearly blank, MUT one saturated smear (1473 / 1173 µg)
